notes.title: v1.051 - Performance, Water & Swimming Update
notes.content:
Hello!

We've been hard at work on fixing some performance issues reported from the v1.05 update, and have also updated the water & swimming within RivenWorld!

The water now looks more realistic and has flows and currents. We did this by doing a water simulation and then converting it into a static asset in the game world.

v1.06 Coming Soon!!
With the completion of this patch/ bug fix, we're moving on to v1.06 to be released sometime in the next month. This update will be adding single-player, and co-op game modes!

Changelog

Added
- New Ocean System with realistic waves and swimming
- New Underwater Post Processing
- New Waterfalls around the map

Modified
- Moved the world environment down 3000 units to support the new water system
- Slowed the player speed down to prevent sliding and ultra-fast speed
- Added transition animations for different movements (player no longer slider side to side when running)

Fixed
- Node respawn bug
- Node not interactable bug
- Random blocks disappearing in claims

Removed
- Old water & river system

notes.title: v1.05 - Visual Overhaul, Farming and Loot
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=qv5ONai5wRo;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello!

We're proud to announce the release of v1.05 of RivenWorld (AKA the August Update). This update has taken many late nights, countless cups of coffee, and some sweat and tears. With this update, we're releasing our very first devlog! Feel free to watch the devlog for information on the update, or feel free to read the change notes below!

Visual Upgrades
For a long time, we've had players say textures were blurry and the game was not optimized, we took time this past month to learn more about UE5 and how we can make sure players get the most out of the visuals in RivenWorld. With this, we have done a complete overhaul of the visuals and the world!

https://img.rivenworld.net/1_5_0/HighresScreenshot00008.png

New Resource Nodes
Since we launched RivenWorld people have mentioned the resource nodes did not fit the environment, so now we've upgraded them with new models and textures!

https://img.rivenworld.net/1_5_0/HighresScreenshot00001.png

Farming
That is right! We've added farming into RivenWorld, you can till anywhere in the world and plant seeds you find from foraging. We're going to be working on a minor update to add more support for farming, adding a water pump to hydrate soil, and a seed station to smash seeds out of fruit!

Looting & Loot Boxes
The 2nd most requested feature has been loot boxes and a looting mechanic, we've added a simple loot box system. This will spawn random loot boxes around the world for players to find, loot boxes are broken up into low, mid, and high-grade loot boxes.

https://img.rivenworld.net/1_5_0/HighresScreenshot_2023.08.08-16.44.09.png

Changelog
+ Added new world design to main release (a lot of changes)
+ Added loot system, and random spawns
+ Added Farming with basic crops
+ Added farming auto watering when near to water sources
+ Added ability to water plants with a bucket of water
~ Updated the building system to use HISM (way more performance with large buildings)
~ Updated the animal speeds, damage, and health
~ Updated deer AI to run away from players If they get close
~ Fixed the bow & arrow
~ Fixed building bugs
~ Fixed forge crashing games (We think we found this)
~ Fixed animal hitboxes
- Removed Undead (for now, they are one-hit killing and that is no fun)

notes.title: Server Lag Bug Fixed
notes.content:
We've gotten reports of server lag, with blocks taking longer than usual to appear and other related things.

After a few hours of digging and running a profiler on the code, we found the culprit causing the lag. It seems to have been related to our world saving system, we've now changed how the world save is working, and it seems we've eliminated the lag!

All servers have been patched, and everyone should be good to go!

Thanks for your patience as we got this fixed, and let us know what you think!

- Keoir

notes.title: v1.03.9 Optimization & Mob Update
notes.content:
Hello Lords and Ladies!

We're excited to announce another big content update and feature release for June! Since we released animals early this month, we've been hard at work tweaking the performance of RivenWorld and adding additional content for all of you!

Immproved Optimization

https://img.rivenworld.net/1_3_9/immproved.gif

We spent countless hours working on optimizing RivenWorld and the environment, we can successfully report we raised FPS by 200% during our testing.

The Undead

https://img.rivenworld.net/1_3_9/undead.gif

We want to add a particular fear of night to RivenWorld, and with this, we started working on the Undead. They rise out of shrines around the map at night and gradually worsen as the nights continue. Right now, they guard the shrines, but in the future, we plan to make them more aggressive and seek players at night to help enforce the need for shelter!


World Overhaul

https://img.rivenworld.net/1_3_9/world.gif

With the new optimizations, we also found a need to replace our trees. This is the first game we've ever built, and none of us our game developers. Though watching videos and trial and error, we found the trees were the cause of a significant amount of lag and optimization issues. So now the world has a new layer of trees we like a lot more.

RivenWorld Demo

We know the player base for our little game is not as big as some would hope, and we're a new studio (a group of friends making a game). With this, we decided to release a demo to let people try out RivenWorld before they purchase.

The demo will allow you 24 Hours to play RivenWorld; you have access to the full game during the demo, and once the 24-hour clock is out, you will need to purchase RivenWorld on Steam.

notes.title: Animal & Hunting Update
notes.content:
Hello Lords and Ladies!

We're excited to announce the release of our Animal & Hunting Update for RivenWorld! We've been working on this for the past month and are so excited to get your feedback on the newly added animals in the world.

Aggresive Animals
https://img.rivenworld.net/1_3/bear_attack.gif

Bear - Spawn near points of interest around the world, they do not like to travel to far away from there location, so if aggroed, they will lose interest quicker.
Boar - Very aggressive and territorial animals that spawn in forested areas around the world. If aggroed they will chase you for a longer distance.

Passive Animals
https://img.rivenworld.net/1_3/animals.gif

Deer - Spawn randomly around the map and are a great source of food and leather.
Doe - Spawn randomly around the map and are a great source of food and leather.
Rabbit - Spawn randomly around the map and are a great source of food and leather.

Leather & Leather Working
https://img.rivenworld.net/1_3/stations.gif

Gather hide from animals by using a sword, once you have the hide you can dry it in our new drying station.

Bow & Fletcher Station
https://img.rivenworld.net/1_3/arrow_hit.gif

Find bird nests around the world, and collect feathers. These feathers can be used to craft arrows to use with your bow.

New Combat System
https://img.rivenworld.net/1_3/combat_2x.gif

We removed the old combat system and added a new combat system that has combos & heavy attacks. We're hoping this will help combat play better without the need to select a different attack angle.

New Throne & King Area
https://img.rivenworld.net/1_3/new_throne.gif

After watching how players played as King within RivenWorld we decided to remove the pre-fab castle and allow players to build their castle and keep. Once you claim the throne, you can build your own castle on top of the king's mountain. This will play into a future update for siege equipment and dark-age machines.

New Movement & Animations
https://img.rivenworld.net/1_3/walking_2x.gif
We've overhauled the animation system to improve all our movement, combat and other animations found in RivenWorld.

What is next?
We plan on working on aggressive mobs at night and a farming system for crops and plants. We aim to have mobs and farming in RivenWorld before the end of June. We believe adding mobs and agriculture will significantly enhance the gameplay of RivenWorld and help add more immersion to the world we're creating.

Hello Lords and Ladies!

We're now T-Plus 6 Days since our Early Access Release on Steam and whoo it was a roller coaster. After EA release last Friday we got a influx of players that led to server issues, causing crashes and disruptions, after pulling an all nighter Friday and Saturday we released minor patch 1.01a, and then later that week another minor patch 1.01b to address bugs and glitches within our server software.

We're proud to announce our first major update, v1.02 of RivenWorld! This update address a lot of things within the world, and will add additional areas to explore and journey into.

New World Design
https://img.rivenworld.net/map/riven_map_v1.png

With this new map we've added 2 additional lakes, 1 river and a different resource node distribution to encourage exploration and adventure through the world.

The map has also been overhauled, and we've added a road system to help players navigate the world!

https://img.rivenworld.net/1_2_night.gif

notes.title: Character Customization, Animals, & More!
notes.content:
Hello Lords and Ladies!

We're excited to share another update with you about RivenWorld and our progress in development. Since the last closed beta, we've been working tirelessly on overhauling our inventory/ crafting system to a new character customization system. Enjoy, and let us know what you think in the comments!

Character Customization
https://img.rivenworld.net/customizer.gif

Once you log in to RivenWorld, you can create a 100% customizable character with over 1,000,000 variations available.

AI Animals
https://img.rivenworld.net/deer.gif

We've been working on AI Animals and developing their decision tree and AI logic. Currently, we have passive AI working with deers and plan to add different types of passive animals, along with aggressive animals and mobs, before release.

Up next will be ranged combat and connecting it to the Animals in the world.

Overhauled Inventory & Crafting
https://img.rivenworld.net/crafting_system.gif

After the last closed beta, we saw a need to overhaul the inventory and crafting system from the ground up. Taking inspiration from Minecraft and games like 7D2D, players can now do everything in the inventory/ crafting menus using shortcuts. For example, Middle Click a stack of items, and it will split in half and move to the slot you move it to.

Usernames
https://img.rivenworld.net/claim_username.gif

Once you join RivenWorld for the first time, you can select a unique username connected to your Steam Account. This username will be used as your name in RivenWorld servers. We add our username system to help players have an identity in the community and on the servers they play.

Server List & Settings
https://img.rivenworld.net/server_list.gif

We've been working hard to implement a server list system and a robust game settings menu.

https://img.rivenworld.net/settings.gif

Thanks for taking the time to read about RivenWorld and our progress towards release. Make sure to let us know what you think in the comments, and we look forward to sharing more news/ updates soon!

notes.title: Land Claiming, Combat & More!
notes.content:
Hello!

We're excited to share our very first development update for RivenWorld!

I was a massive fan of Reign of Kings and Life is Feudal, logging 500+ hours in both games. With both games, I was active in community servers and Role Play communities. Once the developers abandoned the titles, I was left with an itch that no other game could scratch. After waiting years for a similar title, we created it ourselves. With that RivenWorld was born.

Over the past month, we've been super busy and making significant progress on RivenWorld. Completing building, inventory & crafting, land claims, and basic melee combat.

We've written over 200,000 lines of Java and C++ code for the server software and game.

Keep Updated on Development:
Join our Discord
Join Closed Beta


Combat
https://img.rivenworld.net/combo-1-crop.gif

Combat has been designed similarly to games like Mount and Blade, Reign of Kings, and Life is Feudal. All combat in the game is dynamic, allowing you to select your attack angle and swing your mighty sword, battle axe, mace, or other melee weapons at your enemies. 


https://img.rivenworld.net/combat-moves-cropped.gif

Using your mouse, you can select the attack angle. Allowing you to make your moves and techniques to attack your enemies in melee combat.

All hit detection is performed on the server side using an orbital ray trace following your blade motion. Using this, we can calculate the number of hits you give your opponent. Based on the number of hits, the attack will have a chance to do a critical hit. With this system, full frontal attacks will result in more hits than running past your enemy and swiping them with your blade.

Using a multi-hitbox system, the server tracks where on the player you hit and if they had protective armor or were blocking on that side of them during your attack.

https://img.rivenworld.net/fight-cropped.gif

With all this, you can decide how you attack; you can play stealthy or jump from a high point and try to attack from above.

https://img.rivenworld.net/defend-cropped.gif

On top of combat being dynamic, defense is dynamic as well. Based on your defense angle, it will help block incoming attacks that hit you on that side. Using your weapon or a shield to block incoming attacks. But be strategic, as you can only block one side at a time.

Land Claiming
https://img.rivenworld.net/landclaim-cropped.gif
Claim land on servers using a chunk-based land-claiming system. You will need to feed your shrine to keep your claim active, or other players can attack it and claim it as their own.

World Decay
We hate the idea of server wipes, so if a claim dies and no one else claims the chunk, the world will begin to decay the buildings. Restoring the world to its natural state before anyone built there.

Guild System
Want to play as a group? Make a guild and grant your fellow guild members access to your land. Want to build something epic? Combine your claims and build large-scale buildings!

Building
https://img.rivenworld.net/building-cropped.gif

Get ready to build some epic structures! The building system has been designed around games like Minecraft, Reign of Kings, and 7 Days to Die. Allowing you to unlock your creativity and build whatever you can imagine.

Inventory
https://img.rivenworld.net/inventory-cropped.gif

We've completed the Inventory and Crafting system allowing you to manage your items and craft things for use in the game world. The Inventory works similarly to Minecraft, with the server software governing the inventory.

notes.title: Live on Kickstarter
notes.content:
Thank you for taking an interest in RivenWorld: The First Era, and thank you for taking the time to checkout our game!

We've been working on RivenWorld since July of 2022, after having the itch to play a medieval multiplayer survival game together, but we could not find any that were still actively being worked on and supported. So we started to build our own!

We've accomplished a lot and have the game world about 75% complete and the server software around 85%. Making a game is an expensive process. Up to this point, we've self-funded the development but are hitting a wall for the amount of time and money we can put into RivenWorld and still deliver a high-quality game that everyone will enjoy.

With the funding on Kickstarter, we're hoping to not only finish RivenWorld but also make it better and cleaner and add additional features to make it the best multiplayer medieval game on the market.

So with that, we hope you will checkout our Kickstarter and back RivenWorld if you want to see this game come to life quicker!

Learn More & Back Us Today

- Zackary "keoir"
